operator-walkthrough.ref: Admin -> Instagram -> gear -> Pipeline health. AFTER this diff a new 'Image autopost' card sits under the reel sections: a state chip (Paused / Live / Dry run / Unknown); 'Last 7 days: N posted of M runs (F failed, A aborted, D dry runs)'; the last posted slot and time; today's slots with their errors; a 'Last 20 runs' disclosure; and two buttons, 'Run a slot now' (confirmDialog first; the text says it posts to Instagram and the Facebook Page now, or that it is a dry run; it now starts a background run and returns at once with 'Run started <time>; the result appears in the history', the button stays disabled with 'Run in flight since <time>' while the card polls every 15 s, and the result line comes from the newest admin row in the history; a refusal is shown as 'Run not started: <reason>') and 'Pause lane' / 'Resume lane' (resume asks first and names the next slot, pause is one tap). A failed read renders the amber 'Image autopost state could not be read, state unknown, not empty' card with Retry and never '0 posted'; with no rows it says 'No autopost run recorded yet'.
